search.query: index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "HTTP/1\.\d\" (?P<status>\d{3}) " | where status >= 400 | stats count
index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "HTTP/1\.\d\" (?P<status>\d{3}) " | stats count as total, count(eval(status>=400)) as errors | eval rate=round(errors/total*100,1) | fields rate
index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "HTTP/1\.\d\" \d{3} (?P<bytes>\d+) " | stats sum(bytes) as total_bytes | eval total_gb=round(total_bytes/1073741824,3) | fields total_gb

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "Atlanta", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "Berlin", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "Vienna", true(), "Unknown") | timechart span=5m count by location

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "HTTP/1\.\d\" (?P<status>\d{3}) " | eval status_class=case( status>=500, "5xx Server Error", status>=400, "4xx Client Error", status>=300, "3xx Redirect", status>=200, "2xx Success", true(), "Other") | stats count by status_class | sort -count

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "ATL", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "BER", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "VIE", true(), "?") | eval server_label=location." / ".host | stats count as requests by server_label | sort -requests

table.title: Server-Uebersicht: Requests | Fehler | Fehlerrate | Unique IPs

search.query: index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "^(?P<clientip>\S+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\[[^\]]+\]\s+\"\w+\s+\S+\s+HTTP/[^\"]+\"\s+(?P<status>\d{3})\s+(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+\S+" | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "Atlanta", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "Berlin", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "Vienna", true(), "Unknown") | stats count as "Requests", count(eval(status>=400)) as "Fehler", dc(clientip) as "Unique IPs", sum(bytes) as bytes_sum by location, host | eval "Fehlerrate (%)"=round('Fehler'/'Requests'*100,1) | eval "Volumen (MB)"=round(bytes_sum/1048576,1) | fields location, host, "Requests", "Fehler", "Fehlerrate (%)", "Unique IPs", "Volumen (MB)" | sort location, host | rename location as "Standort", host as "Server"

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ (host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02") | eval minute=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%M")) | eval traffic_type=if( (minute>=0 AND minute<15) OR (minute>=30 AND minute<45), "DOS-Fenster (0-14 / 30-44 Min)", "Normalbetrieb") | timechart span=5m count by traffic_type

chart.title: Berlin HTTP Status Codes: DOS-Fenster vs. Normalbetrieb

search.query: index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ (host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02") | rex field=_raw "HTTP/1\.\d\" (?P<status>\d{3}) " | eval minute=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%M")) | eval traffic_type=if( (minute>=0 AND minute<15) OR (minute>=30 AND minute<45), "DOS-Fenster", "Normalbetrieb") | stats count by traffic_type, status | sort traffic_type, status

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ ("185.220.101.47" OR "45.142.212.100" OR "91.240.118.222") | rex field=_raw "^(?P<clientip>\S+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\[[^\]]+\]\s+\"(?P<http_method>\w+)\s+(?P<uri_path>\S+)\s+HTTP/[^\"]+\"\s+(?P<status>\d{3})" | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "Atlanta", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "Berlin", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "Vienna", true(), "Unknown") | stats count as "Requests", dc(uri_path) as "Angegriffene Pfade", values(status) as "Status Codes", min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen by clientip, location, host | eval "Erster Angriff"=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval "Letzter Angriff"=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | fields clientip, location, host, "Requests", "Angegriffene Pfade", "Status Codes", "Erster Angriff", "Letzter Angriff" | sort -Requests | rename clientip as "Angreifer-IP", location as "Ziel-Standort", host as "Ziel-Server"
index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "\"(?:\w+)\s+(?P<uri_path>\S+)\s+HTTP" | stats count by uri_path | sort -count | head 10
index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "\"(?P<http_method>[A-Z]+)\s+" | stats count by http_method | sort -count

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "\"-\"\s+\"(?P<useragent>[^\"]+)\"" | eval ua_group=case( match(useragent,"Chrome"), "Chrome", match(useragent,"Firefox"), "Firefox", match(useragent,"curl"), "curl", match(useragent,"PostmanRuntime"), "Postman", match(useragent,"Python"), "Python/aiohttp", match(useragent,"Jakarta|Apache-Http"), "Java HttpClient", match(useragent,"masscan"), "[\!] masscan (Scanner)", match(useragent,"Go-http"), "[\!] Go HTTP Client", match(useragent,"libwww"), "[\!] libwww-perl", match(useragent,"python-requests"), "[\!] python-requests", useragent="-", "[\!] kein UA (-)", true(), "Sonstige") | stats count by ua_group | sort -count | head 12

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "HTTP/1\.\d\" (?P<status>\d{3}) " | where status >= 400 | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "Atlanta", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "Berlin", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "Vienna", true(), "Unknown") | timechart span=5m count by location

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "\"(?:\w+)\s+(?P<uri_path>\S+)\s+HTTP/[^\"]+\"\s+(?P<status>\d{3})" | where status >= 400 | eval label=uri_path." [".status."]" | stats count by label | sort -count | head 10

index="demo_tomcat_logs" $loc_filter$ | rex field=_raw "^(?P<clientip>\S+)\s+\S+\s+\S+\s+\[[^\]]+\]\s+\"(?P<http_method>\w+)\s+(?P<uri_path>\S+)\s+HTTP/[^\"]+\"\s+(?P<status>\d{3})\s+(?P<bytes>\d+)\s+\"-\"\s+\"(?P<useragent>[^\"]+)\"" | eval location=case( host="atlweb01" OR host="atlweb02", "Atlanta", host="berweb01" OR host="berweb02", "Berlin", host="vieweb01" OR host="vieweb02", "Vienna", true(), "Unknown") | eval Typ=case( clientip="185.220.101.47" OR clientip="45.142.212.100" OR clientip="91.240.118.222", "[DOS] DOS", status>=500, "[ERR] 5xx", status>=400, "[WARN] 4xx", true(), "[OK] OK") | table _time, location, host, clientip, http_method, uri_path, status, bytes, Typ, useragent | sort -_time | head 50 | rename _time as "Zeit", location as "Standort", host as "Server", clientip as "Client IP", http_method as "Methode", uri_path as "Pfad", status as "Status", bytes as "Bytes", useragent as "User-Agent"
